components.name: Mobile send
components.description: Round primary send action; disabled state inherits reduced opacity.
components.html: <button class="ds-send" aria-label="Send"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M12 19V5m-6 6 6-6 6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-send{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", Roboto, sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:44px;height:44px;padding:0;border:1px solid var(--accent,#4f6bed);border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent,#4f6bed);color:var(--accent-fg,#fff);transition:background .12s,border-color .12s}.ds-send:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--accent-hover,#3f59d6);border-color:var(--accent-hover,#3f59d6)}.ds-send:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}.ds-send:focus-visible{outline:auto}

components.name: Mobile model selector
components.description: Flexible selector, with truncation and a substantial touch target.
components.html: <button class="ds-model">选模型 <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-model{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", Roboto, sans-serif;min-height:48px;max-width:100%;padding:8px 6px;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg-sunken,#eceef2);color:var(--fg,#1b1f27);font-size:13px;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis}.ds-model:hover{background:var(--bg-hover,rgba(0,0,0,.045))}.ds-model:focus-visible{outline:auto}

components.name: Mobile composer
components.description: Flat input shell; the production toolbar is composed separately.
components.html: 发消息…
components.css: .ds-composer{padding:10px 8px 6px;border:1px solid var(--border,#dfe3ea);border-radius:20px;background:var(--bg-elev,#ffffff)}.ds-composer:focus-within{border-color:var(--fg-dim,#606a7b);box-shadow:none}.ds-input{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", Roboto, sans-serif;padding:6px 8px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.55;min-height:44px;max-height:min(24dvh,160px);overflow:auto;color:var(--fg,#1b1f27)}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:none}

components.name: Mobile suggestion row
components.description: Unboxed suggestion with a separator and trailing chevron.
components.css: .ds-suggestion{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", Roboto, sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;width:100%;min-height:56px;padding:12px 8px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,#dfe3ea);border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:var(--fg,#1b1f27);font-size:14px;text-align:left;box-shadow:none}.ds-suggestion:focus-visible{outline:auto}

components.name: Mobile preferences sheet
components.description: Flat list sheet; this preview shows its container, not a working modal.
components.html: <section class="ds-sheet"><header>对话设置</header><button class="ds-row">API 凭据</button><button class="ds-row">对话偏好</button></section>
components.css: .ds-sheet{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", Roboto, sans-serif;border-radius:22px 22px 0 0;background:var(--bg-elev,#ffffff);color:var(--fg,#1b1f27);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom)}.ds-sheet header{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:64px;padding:8px 20px;font-size:17px;font-weight:600}.ds-row{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", Roboto, sans-serif;display:block;min-height:56px;width:calc(100% - 40px);margin:0 20px;padding:12px 4px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,#dfe3ea);border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;text-align:left;font-size:15px}.ds-row:focus-visible{outline:auto}

narrative.northStar: Compact conversation within the existing wickrunAI world
narrative.overview: A compact conversation workspace within the existing wickrunAI identity. White or charcoal surfaces, restrained separators, thin action icons, and a blue send action keep attention on starting and continuing a conversation. This is an existing-system mobile extension; desktop composition and brand assets remain authoritative for desktop.
keyCharacteristics: One composer with one mobile toolbar.
Compact visible controls with substantial touch areas.

rules.name: The Semantic Surface Rule
rules.body: Use existing theme variables for mobile components so dark mode follows the incumbent palette.

dos: Do preserve each surface's existing logo and desktop identity.
Do keep model and Chat/Work controls beside the send action.
Do allow content to scroll inside constrained panels and inputs.
Do distinguish browser evidence from physical-device acceptance.
donts: Don't ship generated mockup pixels as functional UI.
Don't duplicate account entry points on web.
Don't turn mobile dimensions into global desktop rules.
Don't describe unperformed automation or device gates as passed.
